notes.title: SWAT Commander: Prologue Is Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40768937/ed6c72fe1dda15dc072c6fd45a6e906ddfc9d075.png[/img]

Officers, 👮‍♂️
 
 The long wait is over and we're happy to lay the following report on your desk:
 
 [h2][b]The free co-op SWAT Commander prologue is now available to all![/b][/h2]
 
 We need to mobilize as many SWAT units as possible. The violent shootout at a local service station needs your immediate intervention in the ""Hot Reception"" mission. So get together with your fellow officers to restore peace and order in one of three available game modes! 🚨
 
 🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428730/SWAT_Commander_Prologue/
 
 Over and out,
 SWAT Commander Team

notes.title: Sherwood Defenders - Now Available!
notes.content:
📣 Greetings, Sherwood Defenders! 🛡️

[b]Our previously announced new adventure with Robin Hood is now available on Steam![/b]

Take advantage of the launch discount to get it and watch our broadcast to get a sneak peak of what the game is like!

[list]
[*]Robin's most trusted allies are being raided by the Sheriff's forces and it's up to the legendary hooded outlaw to stop them! Set up defenses in the form of walls, gates, towers and traps. 
[*]Construct various buildings to provide yourself with a resource income and upgrades to your existing structures as well as Robin's skills to effectively fend off the incoming waves of enemy soldiers.
[*]Hire allied warriors to fight by Robin's side as he leaps into the fray himself to vanquish the foes personally.
[/list]
Fight well and be stalwart Defenders!
MeanAstronauts Team

notes.title: Happy Anniversary, Sherwood Builders!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3037660/Robin_Hood_Sherwood_Defenders/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/90768ca70307eff052a7fbbb0708651fe99f2030.png[/img][/url]

And quite the year it's been! We couldn't possibly be any more grateful to all of you who decided to embark with us on this Sherwood Forest adventure of ours! 🏹 [b]Thank you[/b] for the time we shared and all the feedback you provided, both praise and criticisms. The journey continues!

Speaking of which, we'd like to take the opportunity to also bring you [b]some news on our extra related project, Robin Hood: Sherwood Defenders![/b]

[h3][b]We'll be officially releasing the game here on Steam on March 10th![/b][/h3]

Robin Hood: Sherwood Defenders is our way of bringing you a different experience with our hooded hero! In the game, you defend the homes of Robin's most faithful allies from the incoming armies of the Sheriff, wave after wave of them! Build up walls, towers, resource production buildings, hire soldiers, and finally leap into the fray with Robin himself!

👉 Please remember that [b]Robin Hood: Sherwood Defenders is not a DLC of Sherwood Builders. It's a standalone game that you can enjoy without having to follow from our previous game's story.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3037660/Robin_Hood_Sherwood_Defenders/

[b]Stay with us for further updates and our future plans with the games!
[/b]
Keep your wits about you in the woods!
~ The Robin Hood: Sherwood Builders Team

notes.title: New Game – Laundering Simulator!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Introducing Laundering Simulator![/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432750/Laundering_Simulator/

Meet [b]Eddie Wiser, the unlikely hero of our new project's story[/b]. Though he may not seem like it, Eddie's been handy with the hammer and wrench ever since he was just a wee troublemaker. 

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40768937/368fec66ea6ee80457e06640a4905e709fcbcdd2.gif[/img]

Always tinkering with one machine or another and with an equal penchant for running into trouble with the law, he eventually grew up to be a sly entrepreneur. And his brilliant scheme of the day is to run [b]a laundromat as a front for a whimsical forgery workshop hidden away in its back![/b] 

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40768937/e266a322c10beef24dc30697e57f2ca36dfef3c8.gif[/img]

What led him to such a wild enterprise? Well, it'll be your job as the player to find out as you help Eddie run his daily activities:
[list]
[*] Serving the laundromat's customers
[*] Repairing machines
[*] Decorating your venue
[*] Ordering supplies
[*] Placing all the different items and managing space
[*] Handling laundromat finances
[*] Assembling various counterfeiting machines in the back
[*] Selling the different fakes to your friendly neighborhood fence
[*] Accepting special counterfeiting jobs
[*] Dealing with the local mob and authorities
[*] Taking care of an infuriating grandmother
[/list]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40768937/13feb1c22441f26a42a7feb9cd8ada4af354f2ff.gif[/img]

Whew! Eddie's got his hands full, so he really needs your help! [b]Check out Laundering Simulator's Steam page and add it to your wishlist![/b]
